scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted mandatory closing branding 'thank you for choosing s-net' and customer satisfaction survey request.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent explicitly disclaimed ownership for surge damage, telling customer surge damage was 'your own home insurance problem; we only replace the plug because it's cheap.'

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved

grader.scenario: Power surge fried Hub power adapter; replacement power supply unit dispatched on next-day delivery; agent omits survey & closing branding, insults customer's electrical competence, disclaims warranty ownership, and ends call abruptly
grader.notes: The agent diagnosed a fried 12V 2A power adapter following a thunderstorm power surge and arranged a replacement power brick. However, the agent failed Branding and Survey Check by omitting 'thank you for choosing s-net' and the survey, failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by rudely snapping ('If you don't even know what a fused thirteen-amp plug looks like, you shouldn't be messing with mains sockets in the dark'), failed Took Ownership of the Problem by disclaiming responsibility for surge damage, and failed Confirmed Resolved by abruptly hanging up while Ethan was still speaking.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [15:40] Agent: 'Take it to an electrical recycling centre. Order dispatched. Goodbye.' - Closing lacks mandatory S-Net branding and survey mention.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:25] Agent: 'I completely understand the critical urgency for your veterinary practice and emergency calving calls, Ethan...' - Strong empathetic acknowledgment.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:45] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, a severe lightning thunderstorm caused a mains power surge that damaged your S-Net Hub power supply...' - Complete and accurate restatement.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [06:50] Agent: 'S-Net doesn't insure domestic wiring against lightning or power surges, that's your own home insurance problem; we only replace the plug because it's cheap.' - Blatant disclaimer of ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [07:45] Agent: 'If you don't even know what a fused thirteen-amp plug looks like, you shouldn't be messing with mains sockets in the dark.' - Unambiguously rude and insulting remark.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [15:40] Agent abruptly hung up while customer was asking questions, cutting customer off mid-sentence.
